what: Hand-read verdict for every R5 gate-off value that the corrected metric counts as ungrounded. Same classes and rules as r3_ungrounded_review.json: each verdict carries a quote that must occur verbatim in the paper's abstract, and the scorer (ablation_gate.py --score) fails closed unless every ungrounded row has exactly one verdict.
reviewer: Hermes conductor (Claude) classified each value from the abstract text; the extractor under test is opencode-go/qwen3.8-flash, so the reviewer is not the generator. Confirmed by the operator, Havid Aqoma, on 2026-09-23 (verdict_confirmation.json); one disagreement resolved by ruling (verdict_rulings.json).

classes.correct_conversion: the value is the quantity the abstract states for this field, converted to the field unit
classes.footprint_as_area: a module, submodule or panel size, multiplied out where needed, entered as the area. Counted as a valid area by operator ruling (verdict_rulings.json)
classes.wrong: the value does not represent the field: wrong entity, a slip, an extrapolation, a truncation, or a non-T80 retention
